mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a strong labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 20-day windows, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with an increase in nonfarm payroll (PAYEMS) indicates strong economic expansion, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both INDPRO and PAYEMS increase but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 20-day windows, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) leads to higher borrowing costs, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by 0.5% but SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of the next 20-day windows, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates stronger demand in the housing market, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 60-day windows, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates increased economic output, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 20-day windows, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE decreases but SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of the next 20-day windows, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates stronger consumer demand, leading to increased corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 60-day windows, the hypothesis is rejected.
